name: DropdownMenu
intent: A menu of actions or commands opened from an explicit trigger (button or avatar), with items, separators, and submenus. Items highlight on pointer or keyboard focus using the --menu-highlight token and carry a pointer cursor.
when: A command list triggered by click

chooseOver.because: ContextMenu opens on right-click on a target; DropdownMenu opens from an explicit trigger
Popover is for arbitrary content; DropdownMenu is for a structured action/command list
Select chooses a form value; DropdownMenu invokes actions
Menubar is a persistent menu strip; DropdownMenu is a single on-demand menu

commonMistakes.mistake: Using DropdownMenu for picking a form value
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use Select for picking a form value

commonMistakes.mistake: Nest a Dialog inside a menu item
commonMistakes.fix: Close the menu first, then open the Dialog (focus-trap conflict)
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Nest a Dialog inside a menu item — close the menu first, then open the Dialog (focus-trap conflict)

usage: Use DropdownMenu to help users navigate through your application or content hierarchy. This component provides clear wayfinding and helps users understand their current location within the interface.

DropdownMenu is ideal for multi-page applications, content-heavy interfaces, or any situation where users need to move between different sections. Keep navigation patterns consistent across your application for better user experience.
